inlines.v: BOMBILA'TION, noun [Latin bombilo.] Sound; report; noise. [Little used.] BOMB'-KETCH BOMB'-VESSEL, noun A small ship or vessel, constructed for throwing bombs into a fortress from the sea, and built remarkably strong, in order to sustain the shocks produced by the discharge of the mortars. They generally are rigged as ketches.
